art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Kassadin is an adult armored wanderer with a distinctive horned purple helmet, a dark breathing mask, luminous blue-violet eye slits, and layered Void-touched armor. Preserve his broad shoulder and covered-face silhouette with a fully covering opaque tunic, gauntlets, trousers, and boots. His energy blade is fully retracted into the wrist housing, and no exposed chest, cutting glow, or attack posture appears.
art_direction.scene: An expansive horizontal arrangement inside the square for the complete character silhouette, concentrated facial drawing and loose peripheral marks. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: purple, blue-violet light, sandstone, lilac pencil shadow; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
